documents.abstract: Peptidyl aldehydes were tested for inhibition of dual-specificity phosphatases VH1 and VHR. The most potent compound, cinnamaldehyde-Gly-Glu-Glu (Cinn-GEE), acted as a slow-binding inhibitor with K(I)* values of 18 and 288 microM against VH1 and VHR, respectively.
documents.authors: Park J, Fu H, Pei D.
documents.title: Peptidyl aldehydes as slow-binding inhibitors of dual-specificity phosphatases.
